name: PGC 6510 (Hubble)
blurb: PGC 6510, an elliptical galaxy wrapped in shells, seen by Hubble.
label: pgc6510-hubble
story: A disky elliptical galaxy surrounded by faint shells, the likely leftovers of a galactic merger. Many of its globular clusters seem to be of intermediate age.

claims.text: It features shells around its main body and is likely a merger remnant
Its globular clusters are predominantly of intermediate age
